svg.aria-label: Glyph: a neural network written from scratch in C++ with hand-written AVX-512, AVX2 and NEON kernels, plus an autovectorised WebAssembly build. It scores 97.01 percent on the 10,000-image MNIST test set, which means 299 wrong — every one of them drawn as a grid of the labels it missed. 79 of those errors were made with over 0.9 confidence.
svg.title: Glyph — 97.01%, and the 299 it gets wrong
